Class SimulationSnapshot

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.SimulationSnapshot
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SimulationSnapshot extends Object implements Serializable
Simulation state snapshot for rewind/replay functionality. Captures the complete simulation state at a point in time.
